fcNote: How this is calculated: no AI. For each income source and expense category the app takes the last 6 complete months. Average projects the same monthly value forward. Trend line extends the straight line through those months, limited to ±50% of the average. Each month, income minus expenses is added to today's bank + Wise balance (in ₪). The pension is not part of the forecast. One-off items, like a trip, are only included if they happened in the months used.
